variants.prompt: REFORM OUTFIT/ATTIRE: A striking young woman strides confidently across the gleaming deck of a lavish yacht at sunset, the warm, golden light dancing across her platinum-blonde hair swept back in a chic updo, her piercing emerald eyes framed by dramatic cat-eye liner, as she wears a sheer, black, lace-trimmed bodysuit that leaves little to the imagination, paired with towering stiletto heels, her pose cocked to one side, one hand resting on her hip, her gaze intense and expressive under the soft focus of a DSLR lens in a shallow depth of field, exuding a provocative, seductive cinema.
